report.heading: Calculation basis
report.paragraph: For each bearing, horizontal force = line load × selected span / 4. The transverse bearing couple uses the wind heights above the bearing plane and the windward-quarter-point uplift eccentricity. Direct uplift = −uplift line load × span / 4. Residual moments transfer to the actual node elevation and longitudinal location: ΔM_T = ΔL·F_V and ΔM_V = −ΔL·F_T. Gravity receives the same ΔL·F_V transfer. The resultant checks sum r × F + M at the application nodes about the centered cap/pile line.

Source: supplied journal (34), former §5.3 Entry Reference - Pier; C001, C002, C004, current geometry and quantity modules. No FBMP .in file was edited or verified. The largest span is selected live; if span 2 becomes longer, the node-assignment status explicitly requests remapping.
